manual.title: Start manually
manual.description: Runs when you press Run now.

schedule.title: On a schedule
schedule.description: Runs by itself every few minutes, daily, weekly or monthly.

webhook.title: When a web address is called
webhook.description: Runs when another app sends data to this flow’s secret link.

request.title: Call a web address
request.description: Sends a request to another app or site and gets its answer.

delay.title: Wait
delay.description: Waits for a while before going on.

wait_for_webhook.title: Wait for another app
wait_for_webhook.description: Pauses until another app calls this step’s link.

approval.title: Ask for approval
approval.description: Pauses until someone approves or rejects.

if.title: If
if.description: Goes one way or the other depending on a value.

set.title: Set fields
set.description: Creates named values to use in the next steps.
